steps.en: Freeze an isolated Windows lab on the matching WeChat client
steps.zh: 把隔离的 Windows 实验环境固定在配套微信版本

steps.en: Install the matching Python client package
steps.zh: 安装配套 Python 客户端包

steps.en: Create the local client and enable incoming messages
steps.zh: 创建本地客户端并开启消息接收

steps.en: Injects its spy DLL into WeChat and starts local RPC
steps.zh: 把 spy DLL 注入微信并启动本地 RPC

steps.en: Bridges client-internal messages and commands to the Python queue
steps.zh: 把客户端内部消息和命令桥接到 Python 队列

steps.en: Consume messages or send a controlled test command
steps.zh: 消费消息或发送受控测试命令

value.en: You can inspect the frozen desktop-hook architecture without rebuilding its injection and RPC layers
value.zh: 无需重写注入与 RPC 层，就能检查这套冻结的桌面 hook 架构
